name: MemSpine
one_line: Event-sourced memory library; raw turns authoritative; derived layers opt-in.

arch.product.t: Event-sourced library with a REST and MCP surface

arch.truth.t: One append-only event log (SQLite); every index is a rebuildable projection

arch.stores.t: SQLite log and read model, LanceDB vectors, Tantivy BM25, LadybugDB or SQLite-adjacency graph

arch.graphdb.t: LadybugDB or SQLite-adjacency projection of the log; off in the LoCoMo arms

arch.scope.t: Namespace path is the only security boundary; cross-namespace reads only through grants

write.entry.t: write_messages (batched) or write (single); REST and MCP call the same doors

write.receipt.t: Event appended before projectors run; the returned records are the receipt; crash replays the tail

write.roles.t: Every turn stored as an episodic record with its role; perspective tags opt-in

write.firewall.t: Role trust matrix, instruction shape, embedding outlier, MINJA bridge, quarantine, release by corroboration

write.governance.t: Secret and PII redaction, consent tags, retention classes, chained audit (off by default)

segment.unit.t: Adaptive window (new, opt-in): first of topic shift, 6 turns, about 1,500 tokens, idle or session end

segment.rule.t: Topic shift = similarity below the store's own mean − 2·sd (no tuned threshold); 30-minute derived sessions at read

segment.measured.t: 1,127 windows on 5,882 turns: 0.19 calls per turn, 5.2 turns per window (offline)

extract.calls.t: 0 by default; window mode about 0.19 per turn; sleep stages opt-in

extract.facts.t: Window facts (call 1) or per-session mine_facts; parents = the cited turns; ungrounded facts dropped

extract.episode.t: Episode-fragment section in call 1 (built, off); stitched narrative at session close planned

extract.dates.t: valid_from per record; window facts write 'expression (absolute date)'; read-time [= date] annotation

extract.neighbours.t: Each window sees only itself (gap G-W4, planned)

extract.failure.t: Per-section fail-closed, split mode after repeated parse failures, write-quality counters

graph.entities.t: Call-1 edges section or extract_edges@session; GLiNER2 or LLM entity extraction

graph.resolution.t: Rules (alias, embedding, entropy gate, MinHash) or one LLM call per 50 names per sweep

graph.edges.t: Edge facts as semantic records (rel:, dst: tags) projected into the graph

time.fields.t: valid_from, recorded_at, valid_to, superseded_at; as-of reads

time.update.t: 13-rung rule ladder (NOOP, ADD, UPDATE, INVALIDATE, CONTEST); LLM invalidate_edge opt-in

time.dedup.t: MinHash LSH then cosine 0.92 on the semantic door

derive.session.t: Per closed session (extractive, or one LLM call); call 2 slot built as a stub

derive.profile.t: Reflective insights rendered as a packed PROFILE NOTES header; persona pinned

derive.background.t: sleep(): 13+ idempotent stages; window queue per namespace

derive.forget.t: Decay tiers; hard forget cascades to every derived record and vector history

index.embed.t: Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B, 1,024-d, asymmetric query instruction (arms); bge-small default

index.lexical.t: Tantivy BM25 over turn content, no stemming

index.vector.t: LanceDB, flat exact scan, optional quantisation

read.analysis.t: Rules: question shape, temporal parse; query contract (LLM opt-in)

read.legs.t: Vector, BM25, temporal, perspective, speaker vote (arms); 20+ more built and off

read.temporal.t: Temporal leg for absolute dates; relative dates annotated per record

rank.fusion.t: RRF (k = 60) over legs plus protected pool (top 3 of every leg survive the cut)

rank.gate.t: Store-calibrated gate with named-entity bypass; abstain below 0.25

rank.agentic.t: Agentic query loop, slot loop, fact chain, event ledger (built, off)

answer.shape.t: One ranked list; neighbour windows 2 before and 4 after; dated chronological lines

answer.prompt.t: Clean grounded prompt; neutral refusal retry; date and duration repair opt-in

eval.best.t: 81.4 with protected pool; 80.4 base (absolute values contaminated, deltas stand); official F1 42.0

eval.outside.t: Own harness only; clean re-baseline queued

eval.models.t: Qwen3.5-9B Q4 local for both (declared confound)

eval.rigour.t: Errata, paired flips, noise bands, stage forensics, gold-text lint, blind validation sets

cost.write.t: 0 today; window facts about 1,127 calls, est. 66-118 min on one local GPU

cost.read.t: 0 LLM in the engine; one embedding and one rerank

trust.provenance.t: source.parents on every derived record; trust = minimum of parents

trust.erasure.t: Hard forget cascades into summaries, window facts and vector history

trust.auth.t: Reference middleware (API key or OIDC JWT); deployer's job

trust.sharing.t: Grants, subscriptions, trust attenuation, live views

keep: Lossless event log with provenance and trust on every derived record
Write firewall, consent, retention and erasure cascade
Cross-encoder with a per-leg protected pool (+15 net on 1,540)
Measurement discipline: errata, paired flips, noise bands, forensics
avoid: LoCoMo arms use raw turns only; every derived layer is unscreened
Reader and judge are the same 9B model

extras.t: Speaker, addressee, subject, asker, modality, polarity tags drive a retrieval leg and multiplier
Top N of every leg survive the fused cut (+15 net on 1,540)
Every index rebuildable from the append-only log

token_economy.t: Ranked raw turns plus neighbour windows under a 4,096-token budget, about 0.7-1.6k tokens per question with a reranker keeping 10; MMR redundancy cut; header blocks have budget shares; derived layers designed as candidacy (lifted to raw turns) rather than extra text.

speed.t: Zero LLM calls on write and read by default; batched GPU embedding (32 per batch, 80-90x cheaper per token); Jina reranker 196 pairs/s; window extraction async per namespace with a call cache; full 1,540-q QA run 47-58 min.

locomo.protocol: protected pool; Qwen3.5-9B Q4 reader and judge (rubric + guards), 1,540 q; absolute value contaminated by I80 (relative deltas stand)
official LoCoMo F1 port on the same run
